items.title: US envoys arrive in Russia for Putin meeting after Ukraine talks
items.description: US President Donald Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner and businessman Steve Witkoff will meet in Moscow with Vladimir Putin before flying to Dublin to debrief with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, who was in the Irish capital to meet with European leaders.

items.title: Russia and Ukraine agree to a prisoner exchange as talks end with no big breakthrough
items.description: Russia and Ukraine have agreed to a large exchange of prisoners of war. U.S.-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi led to this decision, marking the biggest humanitarian release since the war began in 2022.

items.title: Victims of Nazi war in Poland call on Germany for support
items.description: More than 80 years after the end of World War II, Polish victims of the Nazi regime are still waiting for a "humanitarian gesture" from Germany. The 2027 draft budget hasn't left them much hope for possible reparations.

items.title: Nearly 64,000 flee Nigeria for Niger where a humanitarian crisis is deepening
items.description: Violence in northern Nigeria is fueling a growing humanitarian crisis across the whole region: 64,000 have fled to neighbouring Niger and several hundred have left for Benin since the start of the year, as host countries struggle to cope, the UN’s refugee agency (UNHCR) said on Tuesday.

items.title: Expectations low as US gives Ukraine peace talks another try
items.description: Although a new round of U.S.-led talks are getting underway to end the war in Ukraine, observers say that prospects for resolution remain unlikely.
